name: Eurasia Fonciere Investissements Societe Anonyme
summary: Eurasia Fonciere Investissements Société Anonyme, a real estate company, acquires, constructs, rents, and manages real estate properties in France. Its property portfolio includes lands, buildings, and other real estate properties. The company was formerly known as MB Retail Europe. The company is based in Paris, France. Eurasia Fonciere Investissements Société Anonyme is a subsidiary of Eurasia Groupe SA.
